svg.title: P&ID Utilities - DEXPI example C01, rev. A: maintenance bypass around PV-4712.02

g.text: REV. A - maintenance bypass around PV-4712.02 (recycle to T-4750)
V-4712.02-U / -D: block valves, DN 50, normally open (NO)
V-4712.02-B: hand-operated globe valve, DN 50, normally closed (NC)
Isolate PV-4712.02: close -U and -D, open -B; recycle to T-4750 continues.
